tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search built2winweb.com and get an answer. Ranks 167 service, industry and blog pages and answers straight from the site's own FAQ content when there is a confident match, otherwise returns the best matching pages with snippets. Tolerates misspellings. Use this first for any specific question about

tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: List all service pages and all industry pages the site covers, with URLs. Use this to check whether a particular business type or service is supported.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Submit a project quote request to BuiltToWinWeb. This sends a real enquiry, so only call it once the user has explicitly asked for a quote and supplied their own name and email. Returns a reference number on success.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: What BuiltToWinWeb builds: custom hand-coded PHP websites for small businesses (restaurants, law firms, dentists, contractors, salons, ecommerce, SaaS). Returns the service list with links.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: BuiltToWinWeb pricing: flat one-time fee, no monthly costs, full code ownership. Exact quotes are per-project via the free quote form.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to contact BuiltToWinWeb or request a free project quote.

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetches any page on built2winweb.com and returns it converted to Markdown (uses the site's markdown content negotiation). Pass the path, e.g. "/" or "/blog/core-web-vitals/".

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_offerings · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_offerings · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
